latest.title: Asymptotic mean value Laplacian on equiregular sub-Riemannian manifolds
latest.abstract: Let $(M,\mathcal{D},g)$ be a smooth equiregular sub-Riemannian manifold equipped with a smooth positive measure $μ$. We study the small-scale limit of the metric-ball mean-value operator \[ A_hf(x)=\frac{1}{h^{2}μ(B(x,h)) }\int_{B(x,h)}(f(q)-f(x))\, dμ(q). \] Exact homogeneity yields the pointwise limit on Carnot groups. On a general equiregular manifold, convergence for every smooth test function is equivalent to convergence of the rescaled horizontal first moments of metric balls in first-kind privileged coordinates. This criterion is independent of $μ$; when it holds, the principal symbol is determined by the normalized second-moment tensor of the tangent unit ball, and the drift satisfies an explicit change-of-measure formula. In step at most two, we verify the criterion by combining a real-analytic finite-jet reduction with tame integration, which rules out oscillation of the normalized moments. We also compute the limit on Lie groups and prove unconditional distributional convergence of the volume-weighted operators on every equiregular manifold.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 刻画等正则亚黎曼流形度量球均值算子的点态小尺度极限：一般情形等价于重标度水平一阶矩收敛，步数至多二时验证该条件。
techniques: 实解析有限 jet 化简
latest.breakthrough: 把极限存在与几何球矩明确对应，并给出主符号、换测度漂移公式以及任意等正则情形的加权分布收敛。
latest.limitations: 高步数流形的无条件点态收敛仍未由摘要保证；分布收敛与点态结论不能混同。
latest.priorityReason: 亚黎曼分析的可复用结构判据，同时明确高步数障碍；技术价值高，读者应先区分两类收敛。
